titulo: Deep Learning for Cross-Project Defect Prediction Using Code Embeddings
resumo: This paper proposes a deep learning approach for cross-project defect prediction. Code modules are represented as embeddings using a transformer-based encoder trained on source code. Experiments conducted on 10 open-source Java projects demonstrate AUC gains of up to 12% over baseline classifiers.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe modelo de deep learning para predição de defeitos entre projetos com validação empírica e métricas de avaliação reportadas.

titulo: Random Forest Ensemble for Software Defect Prediction Using Code Metrics
resumo: We present an ensemble model based on random forests that combines 22 object-oriented metrics to predict defect-prone modules. The model is evaluated on the NASA MDP benchmark and achieves F1-score of 0.81 with SMOTE oversampling.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe ensemble de random forests para predição de defeitos com métricas de código e validação em benchmark público.

titulo: Just-in-Time Defect Prediction Using Change-Level Features and LSTM Networks
resumo: This study introduces a just-in-time defect prediction model that analyzes commit-level features using LSTM networks. Fourteen change metrics are extracted from version history of six Apache projects. The model outperforms SVM and logistic regression baselines in AUC and recall.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe modelo LSTM para predição just-in-time de defeitos com métricas de commit e validação empírica.

titulo: Feature Selection Strategies for Software Bug Prediction: A Comparative Study
resumo: We compare seven feature selection techniques—including information gain, Relief-F, and recursive elimination—applied to defect prediction models. Experiments on the Promise repository show that combining multiple selectors consistently improves precision without sacrificing recall.
justificativa_aplicacao: Avalia técnicas de seleção de atributos para predição de defeitos com experimentos empíricos em repositório público.

titulo: Graph Neural Networks for Software Defect Prediction on Abstract Syntax Trees
resumo: This paper represents source code as abstract syntax trees and applies graph neural networks to learn structural bug patterns. Evaluated on six datasets from the Defects4J benchmark, the approach outperforms tree-LSTM and code2vec baselines in all metrics.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe GNN sobre ASTs para predição de defeitos com validação em benchmark público e comparação com baselines.

titulo: Explainable Defect Prediction Using SHAP Values and Gradient Boosting
resumo: We propose an explainable defect prediction pipeline combining gradient boosting classifiers with SHAP-based explanations. The model highlights which code metrics most contributed to each prediction, enabling actionable feedback for developers. Evaluated on ten GitHub projects.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe modelo de predição de defeitos com gradient boosting e explicabilidade via SHAP, com validação empírica.

titulo: Transfer Learning for Software Defect Prediction Across Programming Languages
resumo: This work investigates transfer learning to adapt defect prediction models trained on Java projects to Python codebases. A domain adaptation layer is added to a pre-trained CNN feature extractor. Results show significant improvement over training from scratch on the target project.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe transferência de aprendizado para predição de defeitos entre linguagens com validação empírica.

titulo: Active Learning for Defect Prediction with Limited Labeling Budget
resumo: We address the high labeling cost in defect prediction by applying active learning to select the most informative commits for annotation. Query strategies based on uncertainty sampling and core-set selection are compared. Results on eight projects show competitive AUC with only 20% of labeled data.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe active learning para predição de defeitos com orçamento limitado de rotulagem e validação em múltiplos projetos.

titulo: Handling Class Imbalance in Defect Prediction: A Systematic Comparison of Oversampling Techniques
resumo: Defect datasets are highly skewed. We systematically compare SMOTE, ADASYN, Borderline-SMOTE, and SVM-SMOTE combined with seven classifiers across 30 project datasets. ADASYN with random forest consistently achieves the best G-mean and AUC values.
justificativa_aplicacao: Compara técnicas de balanceamento para predição de defeitos com experimentos em 30 conjuntos de dados e métricas reportadas.

titulo: Severity-Aware Software Defect Prediction Using Multi-Task Learning
resumo: Existing models predict whether a module is defective but ignore severity. We propose a multi-task neural network that simultaneously predicts defect presence and severity level. Experiments on the Bug prediction dataset show improved performance on both tasks compared to single-task models.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos com estimativa de severidade usando aprendizado multi-tarefa e validação empírica.

titulo: Convolutional Neural Networks on Source Code Tokens for Defect Detection
resumo: We tokenize source code and apply 1D CNNs to detect defective functions. The model learns local syntactic patterns associated with bug-inducing changes. Evaluated on Devign and BigVul datasets, it outperforms traditional feature-engineering baselines by 8% in F1.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe CNN sobre tokens de código para detecção de defeitos com validação em datasets públicos e métricas reportadas.

titulo: Predicting Security Vulnerabilities Using Machine Learning on Code Metrics
resumo: We apply seven ML classifiers to predict security-related defects using a combination of CK metrics and complexity measures. Experiments on 15 open-source C++ projects show that XGBoost achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for vulnerability-prone modules.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe modelos de ML para predição de vulnerabilidades de segurança usando métricas de código com validação empírica.

titulo: Semi-Supervised Learning for Software Defect Prediction with Scarce Labels
resumo: We propose a semi-supervised defect prediction approach that leverages large amounts of unlabeled commits using a consistency regularization framework. Compared to supervised baselines trained on limited labels, our method achieves 15% improvement in AUC on four open-source projects.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe aprendizado semi-supervisionado para predição de defeitos com poucos rótulos e validação empírica.

titulo: Attention-Based Neural Network for Just-in-Time Defect Prediction
resumo: We introduce an attention mechanism over commit message embeddings and code diff features for just-in-time defect prediction. The model automatically weights the most relevant terms for each decision. Evaluated on six projects from the Kamei et al. dataset, it outperforms all baselines in AUC and F1.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe mecanismo de atenção para predição just-in-time de defeitos com validação em dataset público.

titulo: Combining Static Analysis and Machine Learning for Defect Prediction
resumo: This paper hybridizes static analysis warnings with ML classifiers to improve defect prediction. Static tool alerts are used as additional features alongside code metrics. On ten Java projects, the hybrid approach outperforms pure ML and pure static analysis baselines.
justificativa_aplicacao: Combina análise estática com ML para predição de defeitos com validação empírica e comparação de abordagens.

titulo: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Cross-Project Defect Prediction
resumo: We propose a federated learning framework that allows organizations to collaboratively train defect prediction models without sharing source code. Each company trains a local model; gradients are aggregated. Results show performance comparable to centralized training.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe federated learning para predição de defeitos preservando privacidade com validação empírica.

titulo: Real-Time Defect Prediction in Continuous Integration Pipelines
resumo: We integrate a defect prediction model into a CI pipeline to flag high-risk commits before merging. The model uses change-level metrics computed from Git history. In an industrial evaluation with four development teams, defect detection rate improved by 30%.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos em tempo real em CI com validação industrial e métricas de avaliação reportadas.

titulo: Multi-Label Defect Prediction: Classifying Defect Types with Neural Networks
resumo: Beyond binary prediction, this work classifies defects into functional, performance, security, and usability categories using a multi-label neural network. Experiments on the Apache JIRA dataset show that multi-label models outperform one-vs-rest baselines for all defect types.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição multi-label de tipos de defeitos com redes neurais e validação empírica.

titulo: Defect Prediction Using Process Metrics Derived from Code Review History
resumo: We extract process metrics from code review logs—such as reviewer experience, review duration, and comment density—and train defect prediction models. Results on five projects hosted on Gerrit show that review metrics complement code metrics and improve AUC.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe métricas de revisão de código para predição de defeitos com validação empírica.

titulo: Cross-Company Defect Prediction with Domain Adaptation
resumo: We address the challenge of training defect prediction models with data from one company and deploying them in another. A domain adaptation layer aligns feature distributions across companies. Experiments with three industrial datasets show significant AUC improvement over unadapted transfer.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe adaptação de domínio para predição de defeitos entre empresas com validação em dados industriais.

titulo: Software Defect Prediction in Embedded Systems Using ML
resumo: Embedded systems have unique constraints that affect defect distribution. We collect CK metrics and complexity measures from five automotive AUTOSAR projects and train defect prediction models. Random forest and SVM achieve the best F1-scores in this constrained domain.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos em sistemas embarcados usando ML com validação em projetos industriais.

titulo: Temporal Drift in Defect Prediction Models: Detection and Adaptation
resumo: Model accuracy degrades over time due to code evolution. We study temporal drift in defect prediction and propose an adaptive strategy that retrains models when performance drop is detected. Evaluated on ten long-running open-source projects over three years of commit history.
justificativa_aplicacao: Investiga degradação temporal de modelos de predição de defeitos e propõe estratégia de adaptação com validação empírica.

titulo: Zero-Shot Defect Prediction for Unseen Projects Using Meta-Learning
resumo: We apply meta-learning (MAML) to adapt defect prediction models rapidly to new projects without retraining from scratch. The meta-model is pre-trained on 20 projects and evaluated on 5 held-out projects with zero prior examples. AUC exceeds fully trained baselines.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe meta-learning para predição de defeitos em projetos não vistos com validação empírica.

titulo: Predicting Test Flakiness Using Machine Learning on Commit Features
resumo: Flaky tests waste CI resources. We train ML classifiers on commit-level and test-level features to predict which tests will become flaky. Evaluated on four large Java projects, random forest achieves 0.87 AUC with SHAP-identified features related to concurrency and timing.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe ML para predição de testes instáveis (flaky tests) — tipo específico de defeito — com validação empírica.

titulo: Defect Prediction at the Method Level Using Deep Neural Networks
resumo: Most defect prediction targets file or module level. We propose a method-level model using deep neural networks trained on AST node sequences of individual methods. Evaluated on six Java systems, our model achieves higher precision than file-level models for bug localization.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos a nível de método com deep neural networks e validação empírica.

titulo: Resampling Strategies for Highly Imbalanced Defect Datasets
resumo: We investigate resampling at varying imbalance ratios (1:10 to 1:100) on 20 defect datasets. Random undersampling, SMOTE, and ensemble-based techniques are compared. Results show that no single strategy dominates; we provide a decision guide based on imbalance ratio.
justificativa_aplicacao: Investiga estratégias de reamostragem para datasets desbalanceados de defeitos com avaliação empírica em 20 conjuntos.

titulo: Ensemble of Heterogeneous Classifiers for Software Defect Prediction
resumo: We build a stacked ensemble combining logistic regression, random forest, SVM, and XGBoost predictions using a meta-learner. The ensemble is evaluated on 15 datasets from the Promise repository. Results consistently outperform individual classifiers in both AUC and F1.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe ensemble heterogêneo de classificadores para predição de defeitos com validação em 15 datasets.

titulo: Using Natural Language Features from Code Comments for Defect Prediction
resumo: Comments contain quality signals. We extract NLP features from Javadoc and inline comments using TF-IDF and word2vec representations. Combined with structural metrics, these features improve defect prediction AUC by 6% on eight Apache projects.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe uso de NLP em comentários de código para predição de defeitos com validação empírica.

titulo: Automated Fault Localization Using Spectrum-Based ML Models
resumo: We combine spectrum-based fault localization signals with ML classifiers to rank suspicious statements after test failure. Evaluated on Defects4J subjects, the hybrid model improves Top-1 and Top-5 localization accuracy over pure SBFL baselines.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe ML para localização automática de falhas com validação no benchmark Defects4J.

titulo: Bug Severity Prediction Using BERT-Based Code and Issue Representations
resumo: We fine-tune BERT on code changes and linked issue reports to predict bug severity (critical, major, minor). Experiments on 12 open-source projects show that combining code and text modalities improves macro-F1 by 11% over code-only baselines.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe BERT para predição de severidade de bugs com experimentos multi-modais e validação empírica.

titulo: Hybrid CNN-LSTM Model for Software Defect Prediction Using Code Sequences
resumo: We propose a hybrid architecture combining CNN layers for local pattern extraction and LSTM layers for capturing sequential dependencies in tokenized code. Experiments on Devign and ReVeal datasets show state-of-the-art AUC and recall.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe arquitetura híbrida CNN-LSTM para predição de defeitos em sequências de código com validação em benchmarks.

titulo: Program Slicing and Machine Learning for Defect Detection
resumo: We extract program slices relevant to suspicious statements and feed them to ML classifiers. Slice-level features capture data-flow and control-flow dependencies that flat metrics miss. Evaluated on C programs from NIST SARD, achieving 0.89 AUC.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe extração de slices de programa combinada com ML para detecção de defeitos com validação empírica.

titulo: Defect Prediction for Microservices Using Service-Level Metrics and ML
resumo: Microservices introduce new defect patterns tied to inter-service communication. We propose service-level metrics and apply gradient boosting to predict defect-prone services. Industrial evaluation on four microservices systems shows 25% fewer escaped defects.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos em microsserviços com métricas específicas e ML com validação industrial.

titulo: Adversarial Training for Robust Defect Prediction Models
resumo: Defect prediction models degrade when code style changes. We apply adversarial training to improve robustness against code normalization and renaming perturbations. Evaluated on six datasets, the adversarially trained model maintains higher AUC under distribution shift.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe treinamento adversarial para robustez em modelos de predição de defeitos com validação empírica.

titulo: Developer Experience Features for Defect Prediction in Large-Scale Systems
resumo: We augment traditional code metrics with developer-level features such as expertise score, team familiarity, and code ownership. Logistic regression and random forest models trained with these features show 9% AUC improvement on five industrial projects.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe métricas de experiência do desenvolvedor para predição de defeitos com validação em projetos industriais.

titulo: Automated Test Prioritization Guided by Defect Prediction Models
resumo: We integrate a file-level defect prediction model into a test prioritization heuristic to rank test cases by expected fault detection gain. Experiments on three continuous integration pipelines show 35% reduction in time-to-first-failure.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe uso de predição de defeitos para priorização de testes com validação empírica em pipelines de CI.

titulo: Predicting Post-Release Defects Using Pre-Release Test Coverage and ML
resumo: We investigate whether pre-release test coverage metrics can predict post-release defect counts. Linear regression and random forest models trained on coverage vectors from six releases of Firefox and Eclipse show significant predictive power (R² > 0.7).
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos pós-release com métricas de cobertura de testes e ML com validação empírica.

titulo: Multi-Objective Optimization of Defect Prediction Models for Precision-Recall Trade-Off
resumo: We apply NSGA-II to optimize defect prediction model hyperparameters considering both precision and recall simultaneously. The Pareto front obtained provides flexibility for teams with different quality goals. Evaluated on 12 datasets from the Promise repository.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe otimização multi-objetivo de modelos de predição de defeitos com validação em datasets públicos.

titulo: Class-Level Defect Prediction Using Graph-Based Dependency Features
resumo: We model class dependencies as a graph and extract centrality, coupling, and clustering features to augment CK metrics. Graph-augmented random forest models outperform metric-only baselines by 7% in F1 across eight Java systems.
justificativa_aplicacao: Propõe predição de defeitos a nível de classe com métricas de grafo de dependências e validação empírica.

titulo: Systematic Mapping Study on Machine Learning for Software Defect Prediction
resumo: We present a systematic mapping of 248 primary studies on ML-based defect prediction published between 2000 and 2023. We categorize techniques, datasets, metrics, and open challenges. The study identifies cross-project generalization and imbalance handling as the most active research fronts.
justificativa_aplicacao: Mapeamento sistemático sobre ML para predição de defeitos com categorização de estudos primários e síntese de resultados.

titulo: A Survey on Agile Software Development Methodologies and Practices
resumo: This paper reviews the literature on agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and Extreme Programming. We analyze adoption rates, reported benefits, and barriers across different team sizes and industries. No defect prediction model is proposed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo trata de metodologias ágeis sem propor ou avaliar modelo de ML para predição de defeitos.

titulo: Comparative Analysis of Object-Oriented Programming Languages for Enterprise Applications
resumo: We compare Java, C#, and Python in terms of readability, performance, and ecosystem maturity for enterprise development. The comparison is based on benchmarks and developer surveys, with no machine learning component.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo compara linguagens de programação sem relação com predição de defeitos ou aprendizado de máquina.

titulo: Blockchain Technology for Supply Chain Transparency: A Literature Review
resumo: This paper reviews blockchain applications in supply chain management, covering smart contracts, traceability, and governance. The domain is operations management, unrelated to software defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo trata de blockchain em cadeias de suprimento, fora do escopo de predição de defeitos em software.

titulo: IoT Security Challenges and Mitigation Strategies in Smart Home Environments
resumo: We survey security vulnerabilities in IoT smart home devices, categorizing attack vectors and countermeasures. Machine learning is mentioned for anomaly detection in network traffic, not for software defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda segurança em IoT para detecção de anomalias de rede, não predição de defeitos em código-fonte.

titulo: A Systematic Review of Cloud Computing Architectures for Big Data Processing
resumo: This review covers cloud architectures, distributed processing frameworks (Hadoop, Spark), and scalability patterns. No defect prediction or ML model is proposed; the domain is infrastructure and data engineering.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo trata de arquiteturas de nuvem para big data sem abordar predição de defeitos em software.

titulo: Requirements Engineering in Startups: Challenges and Best Practices
resumo: We conduct a multi-case study on requirements engineering practices in 18 software startups. Key challenges include scope creep and lack of documentation. No machine learning method for defect prediction is discussed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo trata de engenharia de requisitos em startups sem relação com ML ou predição de defeitos.

titulo: UI/UX Design Principles for Mobile Applications: A User Study
resumo: We evaluate usability principles applied to 10 mobile applications through user testing with 60 participants. Metrics include task completion rate and SUS score. No machine learning or defect prediction is addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda usabilidade de aplicações móveis sem relação com predição de defeitos ou aprendizado de máquina.

titulo: Performance Tuning in Distributed Databases: Indexing and Query Optimization
resumo: This paper presents techniques for query optimization and index selection in distributed database systems. Experiments compare B-tree and LSM-tree structures. Machine learning for defect prediction is not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda otimização de bancos de dados distribuídos, fora do escopo de predição de defeitos.

titulo: Code Review Practices in Large-Scale Software Teams: An Empirical Study
resumo: We analyze 50,000 code reviews from five industrial projects to understand review efficiency, coverage, and team dynamics. Although defects are mentioned, no ML prediction model is proposed or evaluated.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo estuda práticas de revisão de código empiricamente sem propor modelo de ML para predição de defeitos.

titulo: Microservices Architecture Patterns: A Reference Catalogue
resumo: This paper catalogs 42 microservices architecture patterns, describing context, problem, and solution for each. It is a design-oriented contribution with no empirical defect prediction experiment.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo cataloga padrões arquiteturais de microsserviços sem abordar predição de defeitos ou aprendizado de máquina.

titulo: Software Effort Estimation Using Ensemble Machine Learning Methods
resumo: We apply random forest, XGBoost, and stacking ensemble methods to estimate software development effort using COCOMO-II metrics. Although ML is used, the target is effort estimation, not defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica ML para estimativa de esforço de software, não para predição de defeitos — fora do escopo pelo CE-4.

titulo: Documentation Practices in Open Source Software Projects
resumo: This qualitative study analyzes documentation quality and contributor behavior in 30 GitHub projects. No ML model for defect prediction is proposed. The focus is on collaborative documentation maintenance.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo estuda práticas de documentação em projetos de código aberto sem abordar predição de defeitos.

titulo: RESTful API Design Guidelines and Quality Metrics
resumo: We propose a set of design guidelines and quality metrics for RESTful APIs based on expert interviews and API analysis. Defect prediction and machine learning are not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo propõe métricas de qualidade de APIs REST sem relação com predição de defeitos ou ML.

titulo: Load Balancing Algorithms in Cloud Environments: A Performance Evaluation
resumo: We evaluate eight load balancing algorithms (round-robin, least-connections, AI-driven) under different traffic patterns in AWS. While ML is mentioned for traffic prediction, the domain is infrastructure performance, not software defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo avalia algoritmos de balanceamento de carga em nuvem sem relação com predição de defeitos em código.

titulo: Refactoring Techniques for Improving Legacy System Maintainability
resumo: We propose a refactoring roadmap for legacy Java EE systems based on design patterns and code smell removal. Rule-based static tools are used without any ML-based defect prediction model.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda refatoração de sistemas legados com ferramentas baseadas em regras sem modelo de ML para defeitos.

titulo: Test-Driven Development Adoption in Industrial Projects: A Survey
resumo: We survey 312 software professionals on TDD adoption, perceived benefits, and barriers. Quality-related outcomes are discussed qualitatively. No ML defect prediction model is proposed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo faz survey sobre TDD sem propor ou avaliar modelo de ML para predição de defeitos.

titulo: Continuous Delivery Pipeline Configuration Patterns: An Industry Study
resumo: We analyze CI/CD pipeline configurations in 40 industrial projects, identifying common patterns and anti-patterns. Pipeline optimization is the focus; defect prediction with ML is not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo estuda padrões de pipelines de entrega contínua sem abordar predição de defeitos com ML.

titulo: Machine Learning for Retinal Disease Classification from Fundus Images
resumo: We apply convolutional neural networks to classify diabetic retinopathy stages from retinal fundus photographs. The domain is medical image classification; software defect prediction is out of scope.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica ML em imagens médicas para classificação de doenças retinais, domínio diferente de defeitos em software.

titulo: Deep Learning for Neural Machine Translation Between Low-Resource Languages
resumo: This paper presents a multilingual neural machine translation model for low-resource language pairs using cross-lingual transfer. Software engineering and defect prediction are not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda tradução automática com deep learning, fora do escopo de predição de defeitos em software.

titulo: Version Control Strategies for Distributed Software Teams
resumo: We analyze branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based, feature flags) and their impact on release frequency in distributed teams. Defect prediction or ML models are not part of the study.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo analisa estratégias de controle de versão sem relação com predição de defeitos ou aprendizado de máquina.

titulo: Software Licensing and Intellectual Property in Open Source Ecosystems
resumo: This paper analyzes license compatibility issues in open source dependency graphs. Legal and governance aspects are the focus; machine learning and defect prediction are not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda licenciamento de software e propriedade intelectual, sem relação com predição de defeitos ou ML.

titulo: Network Security Protocol Comparison: TLS 1.3 vs. QUIC Performance Analysis
resumo: We benchmark TLS 1.3 and QUIC protocols under varying network conditions, measuring latency and throughput. Network security is the domain; software defect prediction is not addressed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo compara protocolos de segurança de rede sem abordar predição de defeitos em software.

titulo: Database Indexing Strategies for Analytical Query Performance
resumo: We evaluate composite indexing, bitmap indexing, and columnar storage in OLAP workloads. Query performance is the focus; no ML defect prediction is proposed.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda indexação em bancos de dados analíticos sem relação com predição de defeitos ou ML.

titulo: DevOps Adoption in Enterprises: Benefits, Barriers, and Maturity Models
resumo: We present a DevOps maturity model based on surveys from 150 organizations. Although CI/CD quality improvement is discussed, no ML model for defect prediction is proposed or evaluated.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo estuda adoção de DevOps em empresas sem propor modelo de ML para predição de defeitos.

titulo: Software Project Risk Management Techniques: A Structured Literature Review
resumo: This structured review covers risk identification, assessment, and mitigation techniques in software projects. No ML model for defect prediction is proposed; the focus is on project management practices.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo revisa técnicas de gerenciamento de riscos em projetos de software sem abordar predição de defeitos com ML.

titulo: Code Quality Metrics and Their Correlation with Post-Release Defect Counts
resumo: We analyze the statistical correlation between 30 code quality metrics (CK, Halstead, cyclomatic complexity) and post-release defect counts in eight open-source projects. No predictive model is trained; results are descriptive.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo analisa correlação entre métricas de código e defeitos sem construir modelo preditivo de ML — pode não atender CI-1 e CE-3.

titulo: A Comparison of Static Analysis Tools for Bug Detection in C/C++ Programs
resumo: We compare six commercial and open-source static analysis tools (Coverity, Clang-Tidy, Cppcheck) on 10 C/C++ projects. Tools are rule-based; no ML training is performed, but defect detection is the goal.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo compara ferramentas de análise estática baseadas em regras para detecção de defeitos — pode se enquadrar em CE-2 mas o objetivo é detecção de defeitos.

titulo: Technical Debt Measurement and Its Relationship with Software Defects
resumo: We measure technical debt using SonarQube and analyze its correlation with defect density in 12 projects over three years. A linear regression model is fitted but no ML classifier for defect prediction is the primary contribution.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo mede débito técnico e correlaciona com defeitos usando regressão linear simples — limítrofe entre CE-3 e CE-4.

titulo: Mining Software Repositories for Quality Prediction: An Exploratory Study
resumo: We mine GitHub repositories to extract historical change metrics and explore their predictive value for software quality issues. Feature importance is analyzed but no full ML pipeline with train/test evaluation is presented.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo explora mineração de repositórios para qualidade de software sem completar o pipeline de avaliação de ML — pode não atender CI-2.

titulo: Mutation Testing for Evaluating the Adequacy of Defect Prediction Test Suites
resumo: We apply mutation testing to assess whether test suites used in defect prediction studies adequately exercise defect-prone code. The primary contribution is a test quality methodology, not a new prediction model.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo usa mutation testing para avaliar suítes de teste em estudos de predição de defeitos — secundariamente relacionado ao tema.

titulo: Code Clone Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
resumo: We apply ML classifiers (random forest, SVM) to detect code clones based on syntactic and semantic features. Code clones are associated with defect propagation risk, but the primary task is clone detection, not defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica ML para detecção de clones de código com relação indireta a defeitos — pode não atender CI-1 diretamente.

titulo: Software Aging and Rejuvenation Using Anomaly Detection Models
resumo: We use isolation forests and autoencoders to detect software aging symptoms in runtime metrics. Anomaly detection is applied to performance degradation, not to predicting defects in source code.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica detecção de anomalias para envelhecimento de software em métricas de runtime — relacionado mas fora do foco em defeitos de código.

titulo: Log Analysis for Failure Prediction in Distributed Systems Using LSTM
resumo: We apply LSTM models to system log sequences to predict component failures before they occur. The work targets operational failures in production environments rather than code-level defects in source files.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo usa LSTM para predição de falhas operacionais em logs — limítrofe entre falhas de sistema e defeitos de código.

titulo: Security Vulnerability Assessment Using Automated Scanning and ML Triage
resumo: We combine automated vulnerability scanners (OWASP ZAP, Nikto) with an ML triage model to prioritize reported vulnerabilities. The ML component ranks findings by severity but does not predict defects in source code.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo combina scanners com ML para triagem de vulnerabilidades — relacionado mas o foco não é predição de defeitos em código-fonte.

titulo: Program Repair Guided by Fault Localization and Machine Learning Patch Ranking
resumo: We propose an automated program repair framework that uses ML to rank candidate patches. Fault localization precedes repair; the ML model selects patches, not predicts defects. Evaluated on Defects4J.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo propõe reparo automático de programas com ML para ranqueamento de patches — processo downstream da predição de defeitos mas não é predição em si.

titulo: Anti-Pattern Detection in Object-Oriented Systems Using Machine Learning
resumo: We train classifiers to detect design anti-patterns (God Class, Spaghetti Code) using structural metrics. Anti-patterns correlate with defect density, but the primary task is structural quality detection, not defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica ML para detecção de anti-padrões de design com correlação indireta a defeitos — pode não atender CI-1 diretamente.

titulo: Fault Injection Testing in Safety-Critical Embedded Systems
resumo: We apply fault injection to evaluate the resilience of safety-critical systems (automotive, avionics). Statistical models are fitted to failure distributions. The domain is dependability testing, not code defect prediction with ML.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aborda injeção de falhas para sistemas críticos com modelos estatísticos — limítrofe com predição de defeitos mas foco diferente.

titulo: Test Case Generation Using Evolutionary Algorithms for Defect Detection
resumo: We apply genetic algorithms to generate test cases maximizing branch and mutation coverage in Java programs. The contribution is test generation, not defect prediction with ML classifiers.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo usa algoritmos evolutivos para geração de testes visando detectar defeitos — indiretamente relacionado mas sem modelo de predição de defeitos.

titulo: Performance Anomaly Detection in Microservices Using Autoencoders
resumo: We train autoencoders on service latency and error rate time series to detect performance anomalies in microservices at runtime. Although ML is used, the target is operational anomaly, not source code defect prediction.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica ML para detecção de anomalias de desempenho em microsserviços em produção — relacionado mas fora do escopo de defeitos em código-fonte.

titulo: Software Effort Estimation Using Story Points and Neural Networks in Agile Projects
resumo: We train a neural network on historical sprint data to estimate story point effort in agile teams. Although neural networks are applied to software data, the target variable is effort, not defect presence.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo aplica redes neurais para estimativa de esforço em projetos ágeis — ML aplicado a software mas alvo é esforço, não defeitos (CE-4).
